Extract title from <title> tag

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><title>My Page</title></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
